title: AKON TAXI
summary: Public taxi website for Wetzikon and the Zürcher Oberland with direct telephone contact.
purpose: Give local passengers clear service, vehicle, trust, privacy, and contact information and make the taxi company reachable without an account or booking platform.
responsibilities: Present the taxi service, operating area, vehicle, contact details, and trust information.
Provide prominent telephone contact paths for passengers.
Publish search and social metadata plus structured business data.
Keep optional advertising and analytics measurement disabled unless configured and explicitly consented to.
boundaries: Does not operate a dispatch, reservation, payment, or passenger-account system.
Does not provide a reusable package API for other applications.
Does not load optional measurement when the build-time measurement flag is disabled.
audience: Passengers seeking taxi service in Wetzikon and the Zürcher Oberland.
The AKON TAXI operator maintaining its public web presence.
useCases: Check available taxi services and the served region.
Call AKON TAXI directly from a mobile or desktop browser.
Review contact and privacy information before optional measurement consent.

architecture.role: Private Next.js website composed from feature-owned presentation, consent, telephone, and SEO modules.
invariants: Core contact and service content remains usable without optional measurement.
Consent state gates Google Ads and Vercel measurement before those integrations load.

platforms: Modern web browsers and the configured Next.js deployment runtime.
configuration: Google Ads and Vercel measurement require the explicit GOOGLE_ADS_MEASUREMENT_ENABLED build-time flag.
security: Optional measurement starts only after explicit visitor consent.
